ko: 해 질 무렵 그 강가에 서면
id: Saat senja, aku berdiri di tepi sungai itu
en: When I stand by that river at dusk
sung: 해 질 무렵 그 강가에 서면

id: Lampu menyala di kampung kita di seberang
en: Lights come on in our village across the water
My hair has turned white before I knew it

id: Dalam ingatanku, kau masih sembilan belas
en: In my memory, you are still nineteen
At the slightest river wind through the reeds
I hear the voice that used to call my name
Min, are you still there?

id: Di bawah asap tungku makan malam
en: Beneath the smoke of supper fires
Those words of yours: Brother, go first
Still hold me where I stood

id: Tanpamu, rumah tak lagi terasa rumah
en: Without you, home never felt like home
Little brother, can you hear my voice?

id: Pagi itu, hujan musim panas tercurah
en: That morning when the monsoon rain poured down

ko: 네 몫의 밥을 내 손에 쥐여 주고
id: Kau letakkan jatah nasimu di tanganku
en: You pressed your own share of rice into my hand
sung: 네 몫의 밥을 내 손에 쥐여 주고

ko: 내 손을 놓으며 웃던 그 얼굴
en: That face that smiled as you let go of my hand
sung: 내 손을 놓으며 웃던 그 얼굴

id: Setelah aku berpaling, mungkinkah kau menangis?
en: After I turned away, did you perhaps begin to cry?
It was your older brother's promise to protect you

id: Mengapa justru kau yang harus menjagaku?
en: Why did you have to be the one to protect me?
Min, are you still there?

id: Di bawah asap tungku makan malam
en: Beneath the smoke of supper fires
Those words of yours: Brother, go first
Still hold me where I stood

id: Tanpamu, rumah tak lagi terasa rumah
en: Without you, home never felt like home
Little brother, can you hear my voice?

id: Mungkinkah kau juga melihat lembayung ini?
en: Could you be watching this same sunset?

id: Saat senja, apakah kau memanggil namaku?
en: When evening comes, do you call my name?
Because you told me to stay alive and go home

ko: 난 오늘도 살아 여기 서 있다
id: Hari ini aku masih hidup, berdiri di sini
en: I am alive and standing here again today
sung: 난 오늘도 살아 여기 서 있다

en: Min, are you still there?
Your brother is waiting for you here
I am sorry I am so late, my little brother

id: Kali ini, biar kakak yang tinggal
en: This time your brother will stay behind
It gets cold after sunset, my little brother
Let us go home; let us go together

ko: 대답 없는 강 위로 해는 저물고
id: Matahari tenggelam di atas sungai yang tak menjawab
en: The sun goes down over the river that gives no answer
sung: 대답 없는 강 위로 해는 저물고

en: Min, your brother is here
